detail.longDescription: In case you noticed I was down for a while, or if this might help you anyway… If you're trying to run Cloudflare Tunnel (in a VM, in my case) and it's behind Mullvad (which I run on my host machine), and it simply will not connect to the port it wants no matter what you do: literally, enable UDP over TCP, which is under anti-censorship in the settings, and so I would imagine was never originally designed to solve this particular problem. It does solve the problem, though, or at least it appears to have done so in my case. # Mullvad # Cloudflare # SelfHosted
